name: Azure Anointing
description: Anoint an ally's brow and breast with a cool blue film of soul force that dulls every hurt.

name: Mender's Gaze
description: Fix a steady gaze on a patient and see through it the cracks and tears in the soul.

name: Hallowed Shell
description: Close a shell of consecrated force about a patient so the soul mends unseen and unharmed.

name: Anointed Rebuild
description: Rebuild a torn soul beneath the anointing layer upon layer until the ally's soul is sound.

name: Taint Unthreading
description: Pull a tainted thread free of an ally's soul and draw it out whole without tearing the weave.

name: Anima Fortitude
description: Pour steady force into an ally's anima until the ally's soul resists the next blow.

name: Lapis Recovery
description: Bring a gravely injured ally back through the stages of recovery in one deep cool pouring of force.

name: Lapis Recall
description: Recall the soul of an ally who has just stopped breathing and fix it back into the body.

name: Majestic Renewal
description: Renew a dying ally's soul with a great slow cast of the healer's clear regal force.

name: Everbright Rite
description: The school's signature rite that lights an unfading glow in an ally's soul with a power that grows with the healer's reserve.

name: Heartbeat Salve
description: Lay a hand over an ally's heart and send a salve of soul force with each beat.

name: Heartpair Reading
description: Hold two hands over the hearts of two patients and read whose soul is nearer to breaking.

name: Joined Shell
description: Join two shells of force into one shared shield that covers both healers and the patient.

name: Tempo Mending
description: Mend a soul to the rhythm of its own pulse so every stitch lands exactly on the beat.

name: Heartache Rinsing
description: Rinse the black residue of long grief from an ally's soul with slow warm waves of force.

name: Mutual Strength
description: Share strength both ways between two linked healers so each lends what the other lacks.

name: Fear Unknotting
description: Loosen the tight knot of terror in an ally's soul with patient fingers of force.

name: Heartmend Surge
description: Surge healing force through an ally's heart and soul at once and close the deepest wound.

name: Heart Rekindle
description: Rekindle a heart that has just stopped by driving the soul back into it on the shared pulse.

name: Twinned Resurgence
description: Make two healers' force surge as one against a near-fatal soul wound and close it at last.

name: Concordant Hearts
description: The school's defining rite in which two healers share one pulse and heal with a strength that grows with their accord.

name: Crowned Salve
description: Rest a hand on an ally's crown and let a salve of overflowing soul force run down the whole body.

name: Core Gauge
description: Gauge how full the Core basin of a patient stands and how much it can give to the soul.

name: Coronet Ward
description: Set a ring of force on the patient's head that turns aside any strike aimed at the soul.

name: Cresting Warmth
description: Raise a swelling warmth from the Core and pour it over an ally until the ally's reserve brims.

name: Core Replenishing
description: Refill a drained soul from the healer's Core basin in even streams until the ally brims again.

name: Brimful Cleansing
description: Flood an ally's soul with clean overflow that carries the last of a taint over its rim.

name: Crown Mending
description: Mend the crown of an ally's soul where the thinking self sits and close each fracture there.

name: Brimful Vigor
description: Hand an ally a brimful measure of Core force that restores the will and the nerve to fight.

name: Crowned Rebuild
description: Rebuild a ruined soul from the crown downward with a full cast of the healer's brimming Core.

name: Crowned Recall
description: Pour the Core's overflow into a newly stopped ally and lift the soul back up into the body.

name: Diadem Restoration
description: Set a diadem of restored force on a gravely harmed ally and make every part of the soul whole.

name: Overflowing Crown
description: The school's crowning rite that lets the Core run over and crown the patient with force scaled to the Core's fullness.

name: Zenith Salve
description: Draw clear force down from the height of the Core and spread it as a salve on an ally's soul.

name: Elevation Reading
description: Read how high or low a patient's soul sits in the body to learn whether it is slipping away.

name: Cloudveil
description: Draw a pale cloud of force over a patient that hides the soul and blunts every blow.

name: Highsky Mending
description: Pour thin cold force from the height into an ally's soul to close wounds without fever.

name: Clearsky Purge
description: Clear an ally's soul of every cloud of curse and leave it bright as an empty sky.

name: Skyward Vigor
description: Raise an ally's flagging spirit toward the sky with a steady updraft of Core force.

name: Empyrean Rebuild
description: Rebuild a collapsed soul with force drawn from the highest reaches of the Core.

name: Empyrean Recall
description: Call a newly fallen ally's soul down from the heights and seat it again in the body.

name: Ascendant Restoration
description: Raise an ally who is sinking toward death to a full height of health in one ascending rite.

name: Celestial Physic
description: The school's greatest remedy that pours clear Core force into a patient with a depth scaled to the healer's reserve.

name: Vow Salve
description: Speak the vow aloud as a salve of soul force goes onto an ally's wound.

name: Airflow Gauge
description: Hold up a hand and gauge by the pull of the air how far a patient's soul has drifted.

name: Sworn Shell
description: Close a shell of sworn force around a patient that holds as long as the healer's word.

name: Vow Rebuild
description: Rebuild a torn soul in step with the vow so the healer's resolve binds each new strand.

name: Sworn Cleansing
description: Wash a taint from an ally's soul on the strength of the sworn word and steady clean force.

name: Holdfast Vigor
description: Give an ally a holdfast strength of soul that does not slip however hard the day.

name: Pledge Soothing
description: Soothe a restless wounded soul with the quiet certainty of a promise the healer will keep.

name: Vow Restoration
description: Restore a gravely injured soul in a long labour sustained by the vow until the ally is sound.

name: Vow Recall
description: Bind the soul of a newly stopped ally to the vow and haul it back to the waiting body.

name: Greatvow Renewal
description: Renew a dying ally's soul by laying the healer's whole sworn strength against the harm.

name: Steadfast Vow
description: The school's highest rite that ties a patient's soul to a vow and heals with force scaled to the healer's resolve.

name: Hymn Salve
description: Hum a soft hymn over a wound while a salve of soul force settles into the ally.

name: Cantor's Ear
description: Listen as a cantor listens for the flat note in a patient's soul that marks the injury.

name: Refrain Shell
description: Repeat a sung refrain that builds a shell of force around a patient and keeps it whole.

name: Verse Rally
description: Sing a rousing verse that fills a flagging ally with the soul force to rise again.

name: Hymned Mending
description: Mend a soul line by line along the hymn so each verse sets one broken part in its place.

name: Hymn Purging
description: Sing a purging hymn that lifts curse and taint from an ally with each rising line.

name: Chorded Vigor
description: Sound a full chord of soul force around an ally that braces the ally's will on every side.

name: Descant Easing
description: Lay a high sweet line of force over a lower one and ease the deep pain of an ally.

name: Antiphon Restoration
description: Call and answer across a patient's soul in verse until the broken halves are restored.

name: Antiphon Recall
description: Call the soul of a newly stopped ally by name and let the answering verse draw it home.

name: Anthem Convalescence
description: Sing the great anthem over a gravely harmed ally until the soul has fully recovered.

name: Hymn Eternal
description: The school's last verse that holds an ally's soul inside an unending hymn with a mending power scaled to the singer's voice.

name: Plumbline Salve
description: Draw a straight line of salve down a wounded soul and let it level the tear in the ally.

name: Polaris Reading
description: Fix a patient's soul against a still point to learn how far it has been pushed off true.

name: Stout Shell
description: Hold a thick shell of force about a patient that the heaviest blow cannot dent.

name: Plumbline Mending
description: Draw a bent soul back to true along a straight line until the ally stands upright inside.

name: Haze Clearing
description: Burn off the haze of a mind-curse from an ally's soul with a hot clear force.

name: Keelhold Vigor
description: Give an ally a deep keel of strength that holds the ally upright through every shock.

name: Unbowed Rebuild
description: Rebuild a shattered soul upright and square with a cast that refuses to be bent by the damage.

name: Unbowed Recall
description: Pull a newly stopped ally's soul back against the draw of death and fix it in the body.

name: Resilient Renewal
description: Renew a soul that a catastrophic blow has bent nearly double and set it straight again.

name: Unbowed Dawn
description: The school's rite that lifts a patient out of the worst dark into a new day with strength scaled to the healer's resolve.

name: Horizon Salve
description: Spread a long even salve of soul force across a wounded soul from one edge to the other.

name: Farsight Reading
description: Cast the sense out wide to find a lost patient's soul and judge how far it has strayed.

name: Nimbus Shell
description: Wrap a patient in a cloud of soft force that hides the soul and spreads the force of any blow.

name: Return Mending
description: Mend each place the soul left behind when it drifted and close the gap as it returns.

name: Sky Cleansing
description: Wash a soul in wide clean force until the stain of the long drift is gone from the ally.

name: Homecoming Vigor
description: Hand a returning ally the strength to settle back into the body and the will to stay.

name: Warmwind Easing
description: Blow a warm wind of soul force across a numbed soul until feeling and ease come back to the ally.

name: Ingathering Rebuild
description: Gather the scattered shards of a drifted soul and rebuild them into one whole in the ally.

name: Ingathering Recall
description: Gather in the soul of a newly stopped ally from the open air and return it to the body.

name: Sunlit Renewal
description: Renew a dying ally's soul in warm bright force that leaves it as strong as before the blow.

name: Skyward Return
description: The school's rite of return that lifts a fallen soul from the open sky with a reach scaled to the healer's reserve.
